apps.name: Second String
apps.description: A full fantasy football platform with live drafts, leagues and a real-time game view. Its scoring is balanced so every position matters, and you can swap out a player who gets hurt mid-game.

apps.name: Scene Translator
apps.tagline: Helping paramedics talk with any patient
apps.description: Built at the request of a first responder. Tap a question and the phone says it aloud in the patient's language; the patient answers by tapping or speaking. Works offline in six languages.

apps.name: Yeas & Nays
apps.tagline: How America got here, one vote at a time
apps.description: An interactive history of the United States from 1776 to today: national debt, elections by state, every Congress, every president and every Supreme Court justice, drawn from public government data.

apps.name: Modbus Academy
apps.description: A course on Modbus, the language factory equipment uses to communicate. Includes a live simulator of a controller, a power meter and a motor drive, plus a project where you bring a pump system online.

apps.name: Pulse Prep
apps.description: Flashcards, practice quizzes and cheat sheets for the NCLEX nursing exam, with a 3D human body you can rotate and explore system by system.

apps.name: Fireground Academy
apps.description: Practice questions, diagrams and study notes for Firefighter I and II exams. Installs on a phone and works without a signal.

apps.name: CubeLab
apps.tagline: Learn to solve a Rubik's Cube fast
apps.description: A 3D cube you can turn with a swipe. Paint in your own scrambled cube and it shows you the solution step by step, or drill each stage of the speed-solving method with a timer.

apps.name: Chess Trainer
apps.tagline: A chess coach that grades every move
apps.description: Play a world-class chess engine at eight skill levels, see the best moves as arrows on the board, and drill 77 opening lines until you know them by heart.

apps.name: Turnbot
apps.tagline: Whose turn is it? Every phone knows
apps.description: A game night helper. Each player's phone glows on their turn, says their name and nudges anyone taking too long. Keeps score and tracks your group's standings over time.

apps.name: USA Engraving Map
apps.tagline: Design a laser-cut map of the U.S.
apps.description: Choose roads, rivers, parks and landmarks, set the size, and download a file ready for a laser engraver, with each layer kept separate.

apps.name: Colonel Nocturnal
apps.description: Letters, numbers, shapes, colors, animals and planets in English and Spanish, with an owl guide kids can dress up.

apps.name: Art Portfolio
apps.description: Paintings, illustration and 3D modeling from my fine-arts background, which shapes how I design every app.
